description: Rules and curated exceptions of the derived calendars MOEX_SPFI, CBR_RUONIA and MOEX_RUSFAR (contract market_snapshot/1.6, TDM brief H17, market-data-hub#38). The refresh derives each calendar from the effective days of its base calendar(s) by the rule of mdhub.loaders.calendar (sources rule_*; rule_*_unverified where an input is provisional) and writes the overrides below as source curated (precedence curated > rule). Every rule and override cites its primary source.

MOEX_SPFI.rule: MOEX_FORTS business days: MOEX announces the trading days of the standardised derivatives (SPFI) market together with the derivatives market in every holiday schedule; the MOEX swap specifications name the SPFI calendar next to MOSCOW
MOEX_SPFI.reference: MOEX news n68572 of 2024-03-27 (https://www.moex.com/n68572): trading on the derivatives market and the SPFI market on 29-30.04 and 10.05.2024, not on 28.04, 01.05, 04-05.05, 09.05; on those holiday trading days SPFI contracts with RUB obligations are not settled (a RUB consumer joins MOSCOW = RU_PRODUCTION). MOEX, Metodika formirovaniya tsenovykh krivykh SPFI, version of 2025-03-24 (https://www.moex.com/ru/documents/27002), Appendix 1: calendars SPFI, MOSCOW (, RUONIA / RUSFAR) of the RUB swap specifications

CBR_RUONIA.rule: RU_PRODUCTION business days (production calendar for a five-day week, working Saturdays included) except the days for which the Bank of Russia decides not to calculate RUONIA: every year 2019-2025 the last business day of the year; for later years that day is projected as provisional until the decision is known
CBR_RUONIA.reference: Bank of Russia, RUONIA methodology (https://www.cbr.ru/Content/Document/File/131094/Meth_ruonia_20211129.pdf, page https://www.cbr.ru/hd_base/ruonia/method/), clause 5.1: RUONIA is not calculated or published for days that are weekends or non-working holidays under the production calendar for a five-day week, nor for days for which the Bank of Russia decides not to calculate it. Year-end days without a published RUONIA: 31.12.2019, 31.12.2020, 30.12.2021, 30.12.2022, 29.12.2023, Sat 28.12.2024, 30.12.2025 (CBR RUONIA history, hub md.fixing source cbr, checked 2026-10-23)

MOEX_RUSFAR.rule: RU_PRODUCTION business days that are Monday-Friday and MOEX_STOCK business days (MOEX trades), except the last MOEX_STOCK business day of the year (from 2021)
MOEX_RUSFAR.reference: MOEX, Metodologiya rascheta indikatora RUSFAR, in force from 2026-01-19, approved by the Management Board on 2025-11-13 (minutes No. 84) (https://www.moex.com/ru/documents/metodologiyu-rascheta-indikatora-rusfar): the indicator is not calculated if the first or second leg of the repo falls on a trading non-working day, a trading Saturday or Sunday, nor on the last trading day of the calendar year (Non-calculation days). MOEX ISS RUSFAR history (checked 2026-10-23): RUSFAR was calculated on the last trading days of 2019 and 2020 (30.12), not on those of 2021-2025, hence year_end_from = 2021. RUB overnight RUSFAR only (RUSFARCNY also skips Chinese holidays)
